WITH recent_sector_data AS (
    SELECT sector, AVG(pct_above_50dma::NUMERIC) AS avg_pct_above_50dma, AVG(change_5d::NUMERIC) AS avg_change_5d
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    GROUP BY sector
),
latest_stage AS (
    SELECT sector, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2') AS stage_2_count
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT r.sector, r.avg_pct_above_50dma, r.avg_change_5d, l.stage_2_count
FROM recent_sector_data r
JOIN latest_stage l ON r.sector = l.sector
ORDER BY l.stage_2_count DESC, r.avg_change_5d DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT symbol, company_name, change_1m_pct, stage
FROM scores.stage_snapshots
WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
  AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY change_1m_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;
